propositions: workflow_ms aggregates multiple non-overlapping operation phases without visibility into their individual durations, blocking performance diagnosis and expectation-setting.

Instrumentation must decompose workflow_ms into named subphases (precheck/context, completion-agent, verdict reconciliation, no-LLM passthrough, unclassified steps) using only in-process monotonic clock reads and existing recorder data, adding no LLM calls, Git work, filesystem, network, or subprocess operations.
The sum of new subphase durations plus an explicit residual field must reconcile to workflow_ms within 1 ms tolerance, validated by the reusable duration probe.
Existing aggregate fields and compatibility with older sidecars must be preserved; the probe must display the new breakdown and surface remaining workflow residual.
CI coverage must verify metric emission, partition arithmetic, and legacy sidecar compatibility; local lint, typecheck, and test execution were deferred to CI authority.
